scope: Complete Import / Export / Limits / Recovery parity boundary for Classic MajorMUD 1.11p using retained native evidence plus CodeUpdate0353/0338/0340/0342/0361 exact owners.

import_export.workflow: external editor -> exact native file/version replacement -> server start/restart
import_export.wrong_file_or_version: hard startup/load failure; no conversion/migration path
import_export.reforged_classic_policy: inspect/validate exact identity only; reject Classic import/export/migrate operations
import_export.extension_boundary: Custom/AI compatibility operations remain explicit Reforged features and receive no Classic parity credit

buffer_defaults.classification: exact native configuration defaults; buffer/cache sizes are not hard world-record maxima

overflow_and_admission.give: _add_item_to_inventory checks the native 100 root slots and encumbrance before commit; recipient failure text is `You cannot carry that much!`; sender sees `%s cannot accept your offer.`
overflow_and_admission.room_floor: fixed 17 visible/15 hidden arrays; death spill follows the recovered DFS -> trail -> inventory-only room 164 fallback/loss contract rather than a generic capacity recovery manager
overflow_and_admission.party: leader/self plus five native WORD group slots; pending invitation consumes a slot; full-slot INVITE quirk remains exact
overflow_and_admission.gang: recovered _join_gang validates invitation then increments the native member count; no fixed member-admission comparison is present in that owner

resolved_negative_boundaries.hard_world_record_maxima: not inferred from buffer defaults; lower-layer memory/database capacity is host ownership rather than a Classic gameplay rule
resolved_negative_boundaries.global_world_object_instance_cap: no separate MajorMUD gameplay cap promoted
resolved_negative_boundaries.global_npc_instance_cap: 2000 is a buffer default, not a gameplay admission maximum
resolved_negative_boundaries.gang_member_hard_cap: no fixed _join_gang admission-cap branch; generic Reforged organization limits excluded
resolved_negative_boundaries.account_character_slot_cap: Reforged multi-character account selection is standalone-host behavior, not a native WCCMMUD gameplay capacity
resolved_negative_boundaries.configuration_ranges_live_mutability: external setup/startup configuration boundary; Reforged does not invent live Classic mutation or undocumented setup-UI validation ranges

observed_ini_nonclaim.meaning: preserved as an observed configuration value only; 0362 does not invent sentinel semantics from the literal

recovery.ordinary_gameplay_rejection: state-preserving NoOp; no rollback, subsystem disable, world-load stop, or forced disconnect merely because the action was rejected
recovery.command_failure_presentation: owner-local; there is no universal MajorMUD recovery failure-text renderer
recovery.post_startup_missing_reference: owner-local caller behavior; broad recovery layer does not invent universal crash or silent-continue semantics
recovery.incompatible_native_data: hard startup/load failure, separate from ordinary gameplay rejection

persistence_failure.semantics: synchronous record-level DFA mutations; no WCC-selected begin/end/abort rollback grouping; earlier successful records are not rolled back by a later failure
persistence_failure.shutdown: full buffer flush occurs before Btrieve handle closure
persistence_failure.physical_crash_replay: MKDE/Worldgroup host-engine ownership; excluded from MajorMUD gameplay recovery

recovery.reforged_extension_boundary: generic rollback/disable/default recovery helpers remain Reforged safety features and do not become native Classic truth
